bioconda.name: sincei
bioconda.summary: A user-friendly toolkit for QC, counting, clustering and plotting of single-cell (epi)genomics data.

biotools.summary: sincei is a command-line toolkit for exploring single-cell epigenomic data directly from aligned reads. It provides a user-friendly interface and is installable via Bioconda.
